en-US.name: Folder Categories
en-US.description: Sorts finished downloads into IDM-style category folders (Compressed, Documents, Music, Programs, Video). Extension lists and target folders are editable in the plugin settings, and custom categories can be added.
features: Default IDM-style categories with editable extension lists
Per-category target folder: a name inside the download folder or an absolute path
No network, file-read or notification permissions
